'''Intimidating Cry''' is a [[warcry]] [[skill]] that [[taunt]]s and [[intimidate]]s nearby enemies and grants a buff that grants increased [[movement speed]], based on the power of nearby enemies. It also exerts your next attacks, making them deal [[double damage]]. ==Skill functions and interactions== '''Power''': {{c|help|Normal Monsters have 1 Power, Magic Monsters 2, Rare Monsters 10, Unique Monsters 20, and Players 5}} {{c|mod|Enemies Taunted by this Warcry are Intimidated}}: The {{stl|Intimidate}} debuff from this warcry is conditional based on this warcry's [[taunt]] affecting the target. Overwriting the taunt, such as with another [[warcry]] or through {{c|mod|#% chance to Taunt on Hit}}, will remove the Intimidate debuff early. This can make its uptime unreliable in any setup that uses more than one warcry. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression | c1_abbr = Warcry
